evidence.quote: Here, using cryo–electron microscopy, we determined structures of MERS-CoV spike-DPP4 complexes at defined incubation times, capturing a series of conformational states spanning prefusion, receptor-bound, and postfusion conformations.

Together, these findings outline a structural pathway. for receptor-induced activation of the MERS-CoV spike and provide a structural framework for the development of antiviral strategies targeting dynamic fusion intermediates.
